levels.title: Dig!
levels.story: Welcome to your Moon base, Commander! Your drill can dig up frozen soil from the bottom of Shackleton crater. A quarter of it is ice. Dig, and next turn sell the ice to the lander from Earth.
levels.fail_hint: Dig every turn, and tick Sell ice as soon as you have ice in the store.
hints: Press + next to Dig to plan your digging, then press End turn. The ice arrives in your store.
Ice in the store? Tick Sell ice and end the turn: the lander pays 4 credits each.

levels.title: Power up
levels.story: Drills need electricity. Each drill can dig 1 load of soil a turn, and every load needs 1 power. You have more drills than power! Buy solar panels so all your drills can work.
levels.learn: Machines need power. Buy what is holding you back.

goal.text: Dig 50 loads in a single turn

levels.fail_hint: Buy solar panels first: each one lets 10 more loads be dug. Sell your ice to pay for more panels and drills.
hints: Look at the power bar: you can only dig as much as your power allows.
Buy solar panels, then sell ice to buy more. New machines start working next turn.

levels.title: Water works
levels.story: Astronauts need water, and water is worth more than ice. Your new melter turns ice into water. Melting takes 2 power for each ice, and a little is lost as steam: 10 ice make 9 water.
levels.learn: Turn a cheap thing into a more valuable thing.
levels.fail_hint: Melt your ice before you sell it: water sells for 10 credits, ice for only 4.
hints: Dig first. Next turn, melt your ice instead of selling it.
Melting needs power too: 2 for each ice. Watch the power bar.
Water sells for 10, ice for only 4. Melt it before you sell it!

levels.title: Spend to earn
levels.story: A new base, and not much money. Machines cost credits but they make more. Which machine do you need most: power, drills or melters? Find the bottleneck and grow your base.
levels.learn: Spend money on the right machines to make more money.
levels.fail_hint: Buy machines early so they earn for longer, then stop buying near the end and save up.
hints: The bar that is full is your bottleneck. Buy more of that.
A drill costs 50 and digs 10 more loads every turn: it pays for itself in a few turns.
Do not spend everything: keep enough to buy the next machine.

levels.title: Uh-oh, jammed!
levels.story: Machines that work flat out can jam. The harder your drills work, the more likely a jam: then nothing is dug that turn, repairs cost credits and the drills rest for 2 turns. Machines also cost a little to look after every turn. Dig hard, but not too hard!
levels.learn: Running machines at full speed is risky. Plan for upkeep.
levels.fail_hint: Dig at about 70% of your drills to avoid jams, and keep some credits for repairs and upkeep.
hints: The jam chance shows next to Dig. Digging 70% of your drills keeps it low.
Upkeep is paid every turn for every machine: do not buy machines you will not use.
Three stars: finish with no jams.

levels.title: Treasure map
levels.story: Time for a new base, Commander! Six parcels on the crater floor are free to claim. The map says each one is about 25% ice, but that is only a guess: some have much more, some much less. Scan a parcel to find out, then bid for the best one. Rover Co. wants a parcel too. Bids are secret, the auction lasts 3 turns, and the highest bid wins.
levels.learn: Find out before you buy: a scan costs a little, but it can find you a treasure.
levels.fail_hint: Scan a few parcels, bid on the one with the most ice, and bid enough to win: about 50 credits.
hints: Tap a parcel on the map to see it. Scan it to find out how much ice it really has.
Bid on your favourite parcel. Bids are secret: bid enough that Rover Co. does not beat you.
Once the parcel is yours, dig, melt and sell water, just like before.

levels.title: Rocket fuel
levels.story: Rockets burn hydrogen and oxygen, and you can make both from water! A fuel maker splits 10 water into 10 hydrogen and 10 oxygen. It takes 2 turns, and it uses power the whole time. A rocket lands every 3 turns and pays more for fuel than the lander pays for water. Have fuel ready when it comes!
levels.learn: Some jobs take time: plan ahead so the goods are ready when the buyer arrives.

goal.text: Sell 120 rocket fuel to the rocket

levels.fail_hint: Buy a fuel maker, start it with 10 water, and sell the hydrogen and oxygen when the rocket lands.
hints: Buy a fuel maker in the shop. Next turn, press + next to Make fuel: it uses 10 water.
Fuel takes 2 turns. Start it 2 turns before the rocket lands, so it is ready in time.
When the rocket is here, tick Sell hydrogen and Sell oxygen.

levels.title: Open market
levels.story: You are not alone any more! Rover Co. and Crater Corp. have bases next to yours, with the same machines as you, and they sell water to the same lander. The lander pays 14 for water when little is sold, but the more everyone sells in a turn, the lower the price. Ice always sells for 6.
levels.learn: When everyone sells the same thing, its price falls. Watch the price, and sell what pays best.
levels.fail_hint: Look at the water price. When it is low, 10 ice (60 credits) can be worth more than 9 water.
hints: Water is cheaper when lots is sold. Look at last turn's price under the Sell buttons.
10 ice make 9 water. If 9 water sell for less than 10 ice, sell the ice instead.
Machines still pay: more drills mean more to sell.

levels.title: Grow the company
levels.story: Your company's first parcel has only a little ice, and it will run out soon. Grow! Win a second parcel and run two bases from one plan, sharing your machines and credits. Rover Co. is looking for a parcel too.
levels.learn: Ice runs out. Plan your next base before the first one is empty.
levels.fail_hint: Bid for a second parcel early: an auction takes 3 turns, and your first parcel runs out fast.
hints: Look at 'ice left' on your base. When it runs out, digging stops.
Bid for a second parcel now: the auction takes 3 turns.
With two bases, press + on each base to dig at both.
